heading: DMCA
paragraphs: SEO Group Buy respects intellectual property rights. If you believe content on our site infringes your copyright, you may submit a DMCA notice.
Your notice should identify the copyrighted work, the infringing material, your contact information, and a statement of good faith belief that use is unauthorized.
Send DMCA requests to support@seogroupbuy.in with the subject line "DMCA Notice". We review and respond promptly.
